subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.**

Mrs. Dhar __teach__ in this school for the last ten years.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'has been teaching'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'has been teaching' **should be used instead of '**teach**'.
 
• The given sentence is an example of the **present perfect continuous tense.**
 
• The **present perfect continuous** describes an action or situation that started in the past (usually in the recent past) and continues in the present. 
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is: **Subject + have/has + been + verb + -ing + object + since/for + time**.
 
 
• *Example: I **have been studying** for three hours.*

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *Mrs. Dhar **has been teaching** for the last ten years.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है।
 
• यहाँ '**teach**' के स्थान पर **'has been teaching' **का प्रयोग होना चाहिए।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य **present perfect continuous tense **का एक उदाहरण है।
 
• **Present perfect continuous** एक **action** या **situation** का वर्णन करता है जो **past** में शुरू हुई (आमतौर पर हाल के दिनों में) और **present** में जारी रहती है। 
 
• इस प्रकार के वाक्यों की संरचना है: Subject + have/has + been + verb + -ing + object + since/for + time.
 
 
• *Example: I have been studying for three hours.*
